title: IMU portfolio vs single chalice
summary: Wang Fields 2026 (third woman): citation spans local smoothing, restriction, Falconer, Furstenberg, and 3D Kakeya—not Kakeya alone. After the chalice: what next?

title: Front 1: Kakeya in dimension ≥4
summary: Higher D: more room for tubes to avoid each other. Record lower bounds still far from n (e.g. popular cite ~3.059 in 4D from Katz–Zahl-type work ~2021). 3D weapons may fail on curved hypersurface constraints; no complete ascent path yet.

title: Front 2: Furstenberg / two-ends
summary: Dust-on-lines / Furstenberg in the plane solved by Ren–Wang 2023 with three-branch formula. Two-ends fire-torch metaphor: mass at both ends prevents collapse. Conditional theorem: two-ends in all dimensions ⇒ restriction. Plane proved; 3D key still being forged.

title: Front 3: Local smoothing
summary: Local smoothing (Sogge ~1991): waves may spike at instants but time-averaged norms improve. 2D settled ~2020 (Guth–Wang–Zhang). Higher-dimensional Euclidean still open; some manifold advances reported. Highest cloudy floor of the tower.
